methodology.verification: A chain moves into active investigation only after chain ID, node health, explorer source verification and deployed bytecode match have been checked.
methodology.nextRun: One chain per investigation: identify protocol, validate deployed code, map proxy/admin/oracle, inspect state and privileged actions, reproduce relevant findings in tests or fork simulation, publish evidence and confidence.
